summary:
Plan of w158 (supervision#r79).
Scenario 1 passes today and stays green. Scenario 2 is red for two reasons: six of its steps have no definition (the Given, four Thens, and the second-run When and Then), and Rounds.due makes every proposed initiative due an integrate round, so the initiative goes to started, a round branch is made and the next run is refused.
Decisions: a proposed initiative with no `fulfils` is not due an integrate round, and the check goes in Rounds.due so nothing is changed first (r79, r10, the 2026-10-25 ruling). The run exits as r9 gives.
File set: scripts/supervise_rounds.py, tests/scenarios/supervision_rounds_steps.py, tests/scenarios/test_supervision.py (changes only if the second-run When goes there).
No existing test breaks.
Open cases: a `fulfils` naming a missing request, a request with no accepted lines, the zero-work-item branch review (D3), the faulted-round status (D2), and the no-initiative run.
